exposure: No risk of EOS based on EOS calculator
Risk of EOS based on EOS calculator
cohort: 82 neonates born at ≥ 34 weeks of gestation, diagnosed with sepsis based on the WHO clinical sepsis criteria, and admitted to neonatal HCU or NICU of Dr Moewardi Hospital (Surakarta, Central Java, Indonesia) from May 2019 to December 2019.
finding: The EOS calculator can help predict EOS incidence and reduce unnecessary antibiotic use in neonates.
